title: Login works, CRM returns 403
description: Trace a successful login through a failing downstream authorization boundary without escalating privileges.
hint: Compare the API authorization contract with the mapped claims, rather than treating all access errors as failed authentication.
expertReasoning: The token has the intended audience and has not expired. The gateway removed the CRM reader role while mapping group membership, so the CRM permission check correctly denies the call. Restore the scoped mapping; verify authorized reads and denial for unrelated users. Do not give the agent administrator privileges.

evidence.title: Customer ticket
evidence.body: Synthetic ticket NS-403. Since release r42, support users can sign in and ask general policy questions, but account lookups fail. Compliance users were never permitted to read these accounts.

evidence.title: Request path
evidence.body: Browser → support API → identity mapper → CRM adapter → CRM. Policy search uses a separate read-only adapter. The model cannot issue raw HTTP calls.

evidence.title: Validated token summary
evidence.body: trace=ns-403-001 signature=valid exp=valid aud=crm-api sub=synthetic-user-17 groups=[support-tier-1] identity_mapper_release=r42 downstream_roles=[]; no raw token is included.

evidence.title: Identity mapping diff
evidence.body:
r41: support-tier-1 -> crm.reader
r42: support-tier-1 -> support.viewer
CRM contract: GET /accounts/{id} requires role crm.reader and tenant match. support.viewer is not a CRM role.

evidence.title: CRM response
Dependency health
evidence.body: CRM p95 latency 180ms (baseline 182ms). CRM 5xx 0.1% (baseline 0.1%). CRM 403 for support group 100% since r42; policy-search success 99.8%. All values are synthetic.

causes.label: Expired login token
causes.explanation: The token summary says expiry and signature validation passed; this does not explain the role mismatch.

causes.label: Required CRM role lost in the identity mapping
causes.explanation: The r42 mapping removes crm.reader, and CRM reports that exact missing permission.

causes.label: CRM overload
causes.explanation: Stable latency and 5xx rates do not support an overload diagnosis.

remediations.label: Grant all agents CRM administrator access
remediations.explanation: Broad privileges bypass the intended least-privilege boundary and hide the mapping defect.

remediations.label: Retry every 403 five times
remediations.explanation: Repeated permission failures cannot repair missing authorization.

remediations.label: Restore the scoped role mapping and test allowed and denied users
remediations.explanation: A targeted mapping fix restores intended access while negative tests guard against privilege expansion.
